g.title: Various tools for creating and manipulating Zarr V3 data with the zarrs rust crate - A reencoder that can change codecs, chunk shape, convert Zarr V2 to V3, etc. - Create an OME-Zarr hierarchy from a Zarr array. - Transform arrays: crop, rescale, downsample, gradient magnitude, gaussian, noise filtering, etc.
A library for OME-Zarr (previously OME-NGFF) metadata.
An implementation of the `zarr-conventions` specification, with crates for the license, thumbnails, and units of measure conventions (community).
The proposed `jpeg` codec, backed by libjpeg-turbo (community, unpublished).
The `nd_lift`, `htj2k`, and `nd_zfp` codecs for multidimensional scientific images (community).
A filesystem store (re-exported as `zarrs::filesystem`).
`object_store` store support.
`opendal` store support.
A synchronous http store.

`icechunk` store support. - git-like version control for Zarr hierachies. - Read "virtual Zarr datacubes" of archival formats (e.g., netCDF4, HDF5, etc.) created by `VirtualiZarr` and backed by `icechunk`.
A storage adapter for zip files.
An SQLite-based Zarr store (community, unpublished).
Read-only N5 support (community).
The storage API for `zarrs` (re-exported as `zarrs::storage`).
Zarr extensions metadata support.
Zarr metadata support (re-exported as `zarrs::metadata`).
The plugin API for `zarrs` (re-exported as `zarrs::plugin`).
The core library for manipulating Zarr hierarchies.
A subset of `zarrs` exposed as a C/C++ API.
A high-performance codec pipeline for `zarr-developers/zarr-python`.
A low-level Zarr API for Python built directly on `zarrs` (community).
A Zarr V2/V3 implementation for MATLAB based on `zarrs` (community).
A Zarr implementation for R with an optional `zarrs` backend (community).
Read-only R bindings to `zarrs` (community).
Zarr V2/V3 arrays for Julia backed by `zarrs` (community).
The data type extension API for `zarrs` (re-exported as `zarrs::array::data_type::api`).
The codec extension API for `zarrs` (re-exported as `zarrs::array::codec::api`).
The chunk grid extension API for `zarrs` (re-exported as `zarrs::array::chunk_grid::api`).
The chunk key encoding extension API for `zarrs` (re-exported as `zarrs::array::chunk_key_encoding::api`).

Various tools for creating and manipulating Zarr V3 data with the zarrs rust crate - A reencoder that can change codecs, chunk shape, convert Zarr V2 to V3, etc. - Create an OME-Zarr hierarchy from a Zarr array. - Transform arrays: crop, rescale, downsample, gradient magnitude, gaussian, noise filtering, etc.
A library for OME-Zarr (previously OME-NGFF) metadata.
An implementation of the `zarr-conventions` specification, with crates for the license, thumbnails, and units of measure conventions (community).
The proposed `jpeg` codec, backed by libjpeg-turbo (community, unpublished).
The `nd_lift`, `htj2k`, and `nd_zfp` codecs for multidimensional scientific images (community).
A filesystem store (re-exported as `zarrs::filesystem`).
`object_store` store support.
`opendal` store support.
A synchronous http store.

`icechunk` store support. - git-like version control for Zarr hierachies. - Read "virtual Zarr datacubes" of archival formats (e.g., netCDF4, HDF5, etc.) created by `VirtualiZarr` and backed by `icechunk`.
A storage adapter for zip files.
An SQLite-based Zarr store (community, unpublished).
Read-only N5 support (community).
